config.collins.title: Collins
config.collins.check_modrinth_updates: Check Modrinth for updates (takes effect after restart)
config.collins.only_allowed_sites.toolti: Off by default. On: the mod never contacts any site outside the list below, whatever the server sends. Screens a server admin approved for another site (a direct .mp4 link, RuTube, VK...) stay blank for you. Turn this off to watch those.
config.collins.allowed_hosts.tooltip: Sites videos may load from. Each entry also allows its subdomains (youtube.com allows m.youtube.com). Only used while "Only play YouTube and Twitch" is on. Type the site name only, such as vk.com; a full address is cut down to its site name when saved.
config.collins.cache_limit_gb.tooltip: Most disk space downloaded videos may use. When downloads go over it, the oldest videos are deleted first. A single video bigger than the limit is not downloaded.
text.collins.cache.title: Video cache:
text.collins.cache.limit.current: Video cache limit: %s GB (can be %s to %s). Change it with /collins-cache limit <gb>
text.collins.cache.too_large: This video is bigger than your video cache limit (%s GB), so it was not downloaded. Raise the limit in the Collins settings or with /collins-cache limit <gb>.
text.collins.cache.limit.set: Video cache limit set to %s GB. Older videos over the limit will be deleted.
text.collins.youtube.installing: Downloading yt-dlp... This may take about a minute.
text.collins.youtube.not_installed_use_i: yt-dlp is not installed. Use /collins-yt install
text.collins.video.session_finished_cach: Session finished. Video uses %s MB on disk.
text.collins.update.title: Collins update available
text.collins.update.subtitle: New version: %s
text.collins.sites.title: Only play YouTube and Twitch:
text.collins.sites.status.on: on (only the sites below can load)
text.collins.sites.status.off: off (any site the server sends can load)
text.collins.sites.hosts.none: none (nothing will load while this is on)
text.collins.sites.set.on: "Only play YouTube and Twitch" is on. Videos from other sites will not load.
text.collins.sites.set.off: "Only play YouTube and Twitch" is off. Videos from any site the server sends will load.
text.collins.sites.blocked: Blocked: this server asked to play a video from %s. Turn off "Only play YouTube and Twitch" in the Collins settings (or run /collinsc sites off) to allow it.
